text: "Carpentry involves a sequence of steps that require attention to detail and precision. One key step is sanding, where the goal is to smooth out the surface of a board to a comfortable roughness. Following this, sawing takes over, where a sharp blade is used to cut through the wood. The sawing process can be complex, with multiple passes and precise cuts. Once the sawing is complete, sanding is the next step, where the sawdust and wood chips are removed to achieve the desired surface texture. This step is crucial, as a well-sawn and sanded board will look and feel great when finished."
